controls.kind: Synthetic controls; no native execution, download or real process signaling

refinements: A timed-out scope is failed even when its eventual wait reports exit zero.
Checkpoint files are written to a private temporary file, flushed, then atomically replace result.json.
An interrupted checkpoint publication preserves the previous valid report.
Tool preparation runs in one owned fixed self-script process, bounded by the shared deadline; timeout kills and reaps only that owned session.
No thread is left downloading after a pretend timeout, and no shared downloader globals are replaced.
Git/Go subprocess queries use the remaining collection budget.
Budget exhaustion before preparation prevents preparation launch and marks all planned scopes unexecuted.
Research remains separate, and runtime/boot platform qualification distinctions are unchanged.
independentReview: Pending final closure on these refinements
limits: No native CI dispatch, candidate push, task acceptance or phase advancement.
Root's new profile-boundary and real-bootstrap candidate freeze remains the basis for its final all-source qualification.
Old source-bound execution and preparation reports are preserved, not relabeled as current acceptance.
